key_insight: HarmoVid enables realistic, temporally consistent relighting of foreground portrait videos so the subject’s lighting (shadows, color tone, intensity) matches a target background—without needing real paired video data under different illuminations.
problem_solved: Bridges the gap between image-based harmonization and video: produces relightful harmonization for portrait videos while maintaining temporal consistency, despite the lack of scalable paired video training data.
method: Create scalable training supervision by leveraging image-based relighting/harmonization to synthesize pseudo-paired data and augment it for video scenarios.

Train a relightful harmonization network that predicts illumination adjustments (color tone, intensity) and shadow/soft-shadow corrections for the foreground while conditioning on the target background.
Enforce temporal consistency with motion-aware constraints and video-aware modules (e.g., temporal loss, flow/recurrent components or frame aggregation) so outputs are stable across frames.
impact: Makes practical, high-quality relighting and lighting-consistent compositing possible for portrait video editing and film/VFX workflows, enabling seamless foreground-background integration without expensive capture setups or frame-by-frame manual correction.
